_llm_instructions: Fill out the 'project_title', 'date_prepared' properties. Populate the array for the Duration Estimates based on the context. Context: Duration estimates provide information on the amount of time it will take to complete project work. They can be determined by developing an estimate for each activity, work package, or control account, using expert judgment or quantitative methods. They are an output from process 6.4 Estimate Activity Durations in the PMBOK® Guide – Sixth Edition.

Duration Estimates.guidance: Generate a JSON array representing the duration estimates table.
